confidence_notes: Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal, dorm and midrange meal anchors are triangulated from several Bogota sources, but the sources mix dates (some undated, some 2024 to 2026) and COP-to-USD conversion assumes about 4,000 COP per USD. wine_glass_usd has no direct restaurant COP price; it is inferred from draft beer (assumed about 2x). hotel_1star_2p is an inferred budget estimate with no direct listing average. hotel_3star_2p blends Trip.com (about 59-60 EUR/night), Cheapflights (about 82 GBP average), and a Destination.com median (about 75 USD), with no July 2026 seasonal adjustment. The FX value comes from search results attributed to the RBA site; I did not open the RBA page directly, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors are based on Bogota-specific aggregated sources (cost-of-living comparison sites, hostel and hotel listing averages, and a travel guide), converted from COP at roughly 4,000 COP per USD.
